title: Functional utilities behind the primary street setback and not visible from the primary street
text: Functional utilities (with the exception of solar collectors and electric vehicle charging): i. are located behind the primary street setback and not visible from the primary street; ii. are designed to integrate with the development; and iii. are located and/or screened so that they are not visually obtrusive and minimise the impact of noise sources to habitable rooms and private open space both on the development site and adjoining properties.

replaces.note: solar collectors on roofs; exempt under the Regulations, register C4P1-056

notes: from: ch3 C2.5.2 (evaluator unchanged). Only (i) is encoded; (ii) and (iii) need a planner and fall to M2.5. Solar collectors and EV charging excluded.
